tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dharmā s+ya swā mi shrī man+sad+gu re bh+yas+sadharmā ya thā shū ta s+ya na yas+su bha gi ta gam+bhi ra puṣ+ṭiṃ dharmā s+sarba kā sha s+ya sur+ya nā ma bi ha ra tisma/ ༄༅/ /chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thob pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed las rje btsun grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyis rjes su bzung ba'i sarga ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharmā s+ya swā mi shrī man+sad+gu re bh+yas+sadharmā ya thā shū ta s+ya na yas+su bha gi ta gam+bhi ra puṣ+ṭiṃ dharmā s+sarba kā sha s+ya sur+ya nā maḥ bod skad du/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thob pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma bka' drin can rnams kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su gzung du gsol/ sngon tshe grangs med bskal pa'i dus nas yan lag bdun ldan sku brnyes kyang / /gdul bya drang phyir 'phags pa'i yul du mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston mdzad pa'i/ /lha mi'i mgon po zas gtsang sras dang des gsungs lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin dge 'dun tshogs la byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ 1 /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mdo dang sngags kyi bka'/ /mkha' mnyam gdul bya'i don du bsdud mdzad pa'i/ /gsang ba'i bdag dang dgra bcom byang sems tshogs/ /rim par byon pa rnams la bdag cag dad/ 2 /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa'i gsung rab kyi/ /dgongs pa rang dbang 'grel ba'i skyes chen mchog /'phags yul mdzes par byed pa'i 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /paṇa grub dbang po de dag phyag gi gnas/ 3 /bod yul mtha' 'khob mun pa'i gling chen por/ /dam chos nyi mas kun tu gsal mdzad pa'i/

/'jig rten mig gyur sgra bsgyur lo paṇa rnams/ /bka' drin dran pas yang yang phyag bgyi 'o/ 4 /gangs can ljongs 'dir mdo sngags phyogs re ba'i/ /bstan 'dzin mang yang yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mthu stobs mgon po yis/ /mngon sum rjes bzung sa skya'i bla chen rgyal/ 5 /de sras thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rtse/ /bod yul rdor 'dzin gtsug rgyan grags pa'i mtshan/ /thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen dang / /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i yon tan bsam bzhin 'dud/ 6 /de lta'i skyes chen rnams kyi bstan pa'i rgyun/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir ches cher gsal ba la/ /gzhan dang mtshungs pa med pa'i mdzad pa can/ /sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen gtsug na mdzes/ 7 /gang sku nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'bar zhing / /de gsung lugs gnyis 'dod pa 'jo ba can/ /khyod thugs byis pa'i blo yis dpag dka' ba'i/ /grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan gyis bdag skyongs shig 8 /snyigs dus dmu rgod 'dul dka'i sems can rnams/ /'jam des zhi ba chen po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /'dul mkhas ji mdzad bstan 'gro'i don gyur pa'i/ /yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas gang des srungs/ 9 /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs mchog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol ba'i lha/ /lha mchog dkyil 'khor gtso bo rigs brgya'i bdag /bdag gi skyabs gcig rje btsun mus par 'dud/ 10 /gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa gces 'dzin pa'i/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad don gnyis lhun grub dang / /sbyin sogs phar phyin spyod pa mthar son pa'i/ /snyan pa'i grags pa gsal de bsngags par 'os/ 11 /zab yangs man ngag kun la dbang phyug pa'i/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin zab mor rab brtan dang / /ngag dbang lha dang dbyer med thams cad mkhyen/ /chos kyi grags pa srid na gsal de bsngags/ 12 /de sogs rtsa rgyud bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /dam chos thos tshul legs par bshad pa'i gtam/

/zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed 'di/ /'chad par 'gyur gyi don gnyer dga' bas nyon/ 13 /'dir skal ba dang ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams shin tu rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che lan cig tsam thob pa'i dus 'dir/ rang dang pha ma rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad rnam par grol ba rin po che'i gling du phyin par byed pa'i thabs la dus 'khor mo yug tu 'bad par bya dgos pa yin te/ ji skad du/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni/ /sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ /gru 'di shin tu rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs pas so/ /ji ltar 'bad par bya ba'i tshul yang / chos mngon pa las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thog ma nyid du legs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che la gnas dgos pa yin pa las/ tshul khrims de yang / rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin rang gi ngo bo 'o/ /zhes dang / bde mchog gi gzhung las/ gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni gzung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhi sdom pa gsum thob la ma nyams par byas nas/ de'i 'og tu brgyud pa dri ma med pa las 'ongs pa'i gsung rab rnam par dag pa'i tshig don rnams/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang bsgom pa'i tshul la brtson 'grus dang nan tan snying por bgyid pa'i sgo nas dal 'byor gyi rten lan cig tsam thob pa 'di don yod par bya dgos pa las/ bdag cag gis yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs te dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi ji ltar thos pa'i tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ gang gi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong tsam gyis/ /'gro kun dbang du bsdu ba'i mthu stobs can/

/pad+ma 'byung gnas dus mthar dge slong tshul/ /grub mchog bsod nams dbang por snying nas 'dud/ /ces pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa bdag cag gi 'dren mchog /sa gsum gyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba'i drung du/ rang lo bcu bzhir slebs pa 'phags pa'i yul na thun mong zhes grags pa lcags pho khyi'i lo dbo zla ba'i yar ngo'i gral tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying mar bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i dbang po/ shī ri pu tra/ rgyal po'i khab shing thag can du 'khrungs pa/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ grong khyer ser skyar/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ rā ḍar 'khrungs pa'i sa ra ha yin/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ lho phyogs bai ta'i yul/ gu ṇa mi ṭa/ 'dis dbu ma rtsa shes la 'grel pa mdzad/ rin chen bshes gnyen/ lam 'bras kyi lo rgyus su dharmā mi trar bshad/ dpal ldan chos skyong / zla ba'i grong du 'khrungs pa'i bi ru pa yin/ gu ṇa pa ri/ chos kyi phreng ba/ 'byung gnas sbas pa/ dran pa nyer bzhag phyis 'gyur gyi paṇ+ṭi ta/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī/ kha che khri brtan gyi grong khyer sra lwa rang rar 'khrungs pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ chos rje mnyam med pa/ sngags 'chang gzungs dpal/ chos rje dge bzang pa/ chos rje ā nan+da pa/ grub chen chos kyi rin chen/ sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ chos rje chos rgyal dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen nam mkha' dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam mgon grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ dus phyis dpal sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i khur 'di mi bya ba mthu med byung ba nas/

dge tshul dang tshangs spyod dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa 'bul tshogs bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ming btags tsam du gnas pa lags/ /yang na kha che paṇa chen gyi rjes su/ mkhan chen rdo rje dpal/ mkhan chen 'od zer dpal/ mkhan chen bsod nams dpal/ mkhan chen bkras tshul/ shar pa ye rgyal/ ngor chen kun bzang / byams chen rab 'byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang / spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rje de nyid kyi drung du/ dbu sems kyi lugs las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi cho ga'i sems bskyed kyi sdom pa thob nas/ de'i yig cha rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung yang nos so/ /dbang gi skor la/ thog mar grub chen dzā+e ta ri'i lugs kyi mgon po tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ slob dpon byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ bla chen bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma bkra shis 'od zer/ e pa 'khon ston/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ye/ grags pa dpal/ sru lung pa kun smon/ brag phug pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ /yang na ngor chen mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin man sngar bzhin no/

༈ /yang ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti pu pa/ ras chung ba/ mi la ras pa/ dwags po lha rje/ tha tsa ba/ 'bri gung pa/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin chen ldan/ rje zur phug pa/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal/ chos rje bde legs rin chen/ kun dga' dpal bzang / dbu ma pa dpal ldan bzang po/ drin chen dpal ldan mgon po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ /yang bla med rdo rje theg pa'i smin byed kyi thog ma rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bka' rnam par dag pa smin rgyas su thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ 'khon rdo rje rin chen/ 'khon shes rab yon tan/ 'khon rdo rje gtsug tor/ 'khon dge skyabs/ 'khon dge mthong / 'khon ston bal po/ 'khon shākya blo gros/ 'khon shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ kha 'ub pa 'od ldan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun rgyal/ theg chen kun bkras/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ /yang na chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi rjes su/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/

rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo chen po man gong dang 'dra/ yang na rje btsun pa/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ yang na rje sa paṇa/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ 'phags pa/ mchog ldan/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal man 'dra'o/ /phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i 'gyur/ dkyil mchog las rim slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa de nyid dang mnyam dzñā na ku mā ras bsgyur ba/ sgrub thabs bklags pas don grub/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ phur pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma rje btsun pas mdzad par grags pa rnams thos/ ༈ /dpal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i ring rgyud ni/ spyi dang 'dra la/ sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud bar la ma chad pa'i nye rgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ bla chen kun rgyal/ theg chen rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ /des bdag la'o/ ༈ /nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba lan gnyis thob pa'i brgyud pa ni gsung ngag dang 'dra bas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a wa dhu ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba/

zhang dgon pa ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ bla ma ne tshe sbal ston/ slob dpon bye ba lung pa/ bla ma shes rab grags/ gnam ba 'phar chos shes/ mngon pa dbu dkar ba/ dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ de la 'phags pa rin chen dang / paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje shes rab/ de gnyis ka la zhang dkon mchog dpal/ de la chos rje brag phug pa/ de la bla ma dam pa dang / ri khrod pa gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka la bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de la chos rje shar pa dang / grub chen bud+dha ba gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka la bla ma rdo rje 'chang / de la sems dpa' chen po/ de gnyis ka la rje btsun dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug pa dang / kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge de gnyis char la 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog 'phel/ sa lo chen po/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'dren mchog rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chen po man 'dra'o/ /yang na mngon pa ba/ 'phags pa/ sgang ston shes rab 'bum/ dkar po brag pa/ bla ma dpal ldan pa man chad gong dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /yang chos rje de nyid kyi drung du/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs pa legs par thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ thog mar sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi khrid dang rjes su 'brel bar brgyud pa'i rnam thar rnams thos pa la/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus/ bod kyi lo rgyus rgyas pa dmar gyis mdzad pa/ sa chen gyi rnam thar rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ rje rtse mo'i rnam thar tshangs spyod ma dang / khyod nyid ma mchan ma rje pas mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyi rnam thar mnal lam ma sbal ston gyis mdzad pa dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rje sa paṇa gyi rnam thar 'phags pas mdzad pa dang / lho pa rin chen dpal gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa'i rnam thar shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dang /

byang gzhon bo dhi ku ma ras mdzad pa/ tshogs bsgom pa'i rnam thar dang nyan chen pa'i rnam thar bar ston gyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus las btus pa/ nyan chen pa'i rnam thar dkar po brag pas mdzad pa/ zhang pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ brag phug pa'i rnam thar ri khrod pas mdzad pa/ bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa dang / karma byams chos pas mdzad pa kha skong dang bcas pa/ ri khrod pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ dkar po brag pa'i rnam thar rang nyid kyis mdzad pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa'i rnam thar sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa/ grub chen bud+dha shrī'i rnam thar ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ shar chen ye rgyal gyi rnam thar rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa mus chen gyis mdzad pa/ mus chen gyi rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa rtsa 'grel kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen gyi rnam thar rje sangs rin gyis mdzad pa/ rje dkon mchog 'phel gyi rnam thar mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen dang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rje sangs rin gyi rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa sa los mdzad pa/ sa lo chen po'i rnam thar ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rnam thar dkon mchog dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar rgyas pa ljags steng nas gnang zhing / bla ma bsten pa'i thabs sh+lau ka lnga bcu pa rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i dka' 'grel dang bcas pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i snang gsum mdzes rgyan gyi lung rnams dang / brgyud pa gnyis las 'ongs pa'i dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga rnams legs par thos/ lam gyi dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas dkri ba la/ thog mar yab kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba rtsa sngags āṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung dang bcas pa/

lus dkyil gyi khrid kyi sngon 'gror thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang bskur ba gsang sngags yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas lung dang bcas pa/ gsang dbang gi lam gyi sngon 'gror rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor dang / bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par bskur ba lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang byin rlabs/ phyi'i bar chad srung thabs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gi srung ba thun mong ba'i byin rlabs rnams legs par thob nas/ de rnams kyi rgyab rten tshad ma bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yig sna rnams kyi lung thob pa la/ thog mar bstan bcos rdo rje'i tshig rkang / de'i rnam 'grel rje sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa bcu gcig nang nas tshig nyung la don rgyas pa gnyag ma yig chung dang bcas pa la deng sang lam 'bras glegs bam zhes mtshan du grags pa 'di'i nang na bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rnam 'grel gnyag ma dang / /gsal byed kun gzhi rgyu rgyud gdan sogs dang / /lus dkyil 'chi bslu bum dbang 'da' ka ma/ /thig le'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid dang / /bzhi pa'i 'da' ka bar do'i gdams ngag dang / /lam dbang tshad ma bzhi dang gdams ngag drug /rten 'brel lnga dang grib sel yig chung gnyis/ /thig le srung ba yig brgya'i 'don thabs dang / /rlung sbyor bha ga'i yi ge 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ /dbang phyug don brgyad sa phyed mngon rtogs dang / /don bsdus ma ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ /bstan bcos nyid kyi steng du bshad bya 'o/ /de dag las 'phros gud du gsungs pa'i chos/ /'khor 'das dbyer med dbang bzhi'i man ngag gnad/ /mchog dbang bskur tshul bskyed rim bsdus pa dang / /ril bu'i sgrub thabs yum gyi byin rlabs dang / /gegs sel bzhi dang dbang chu sgrub thabs gsum/

/rtsa ltung 'khrul spong tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg ste/ /rtsa ba las 'phros chos sna bcu bdun pa las/ /phyi ma bdun po logs su bzhugs kyang rung / /'bring bsdus lam gnyis gzhung shing chen po bzhi/ /rtogs bskyed chos lnga lam zab bla ma rnams/ /nyams myong tshad ma'i chos sna nyer dgu yin/ /lung gi tshad ma lung sbyor rnam pa bzhi/ /bla ma tshad ma rgya bod rnam thar gnyis/ /man ngag phra mor bcas pa drug bcu 'o/ /zhes pa ltar glegs bam dkar chag tu thebs pa'i chos sna drug cu las/ glegs bam 'dir cis kyang bzhugs dgos pa'i chos sna zhe dgu las/ dang po pa dang / thun mong du logs su bzhugs kyang rung ba'i chos sna bdun dang bcas pa legs par thos/ man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs logs su bsgrigs pa mtshan po ti dmar btus su grags pa thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ thog mar bla ma tshad ma'i skabs su/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rje pas mdzad pa/ de'i kha skong shar pas mdzad pa/ sa bir mjal ba'i lo rgyus rje pas sga thang la gnang ba/ nyams myong tshad ma'i skabs su gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i khrid yig rje pas bra ston la gnang ba/ smin byed kyi skabs su sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor dang / aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ aṣ+ṭa'i gzhi bshad sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub thabs 'phags pas mdzad pa/ dbang gi rab dbye rje pa'i gsung las zhang btsun gyis bris pa/ rje pas sga ston la springs pa/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ de'i kha skong shar chen gyis mdzad pa/ lus sbyong nyi shu pa nor bzang gis mdzad pa/ lus gnad kyi man ngag dmar gyis mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs rje pas mdzad pa/ gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa nyer dgu/ gegs sel gsang bdun ma/ bar chad gsum sel/ bka' rgya ma/ nyams che chung / gleng gzhi ma/ rlung reng lnga bcos pa sogs 'byung ba lus 'khrugs sogs sel ba/

gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi'i gsal byed rnams sa paṇa gyi gsung 'gros yi ge rnying pa/ 'phrin las so gnyis kyi sdom tshig dang de'i zhal shes bud+dha shrīs mdzad pa/ dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod rtsa 'grel sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ brda don gsal ba rtsa 'grel sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa lho pa'i zin bris/ bstan bcos tshad ma'i skabs su gnad du che ba drug gi yig rnying / rten 'brel lnga sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ lam bsdus pa dmar gyis mdzad pa/ phyag chen gyi dbye ba sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ tshogs sbyor gyi mngon rtogs 'phags pas mdzad pa/ 'khor bzhi'i rgya sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ lam bsdus pa'i bshad pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ bsgrub pa lung sbyin sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ gsang ba bcu'i rgyas gdab sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ lung tshad ma la lugs 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa/ de'i gsal byed kyi yi ge cig dang bcas pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis sa chen la gnang ba'i zab chos bzhir grags pa la lam zab kyi khrid yig sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ bla ma rin 'byung dmar gyis mdzad pa/ lam sbas bshad sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ pho brang lnga'i sbas bshad yig rnying / sbas bshad kyi 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ gru phra rtsa 'grel sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ gsal byed bud+dha shris mdzad pa/ bir srung gi man ngag rnying pa gsum/ bir srung gi man ngag byin rlabs byed tshul dang bcas pa 'phags pas mdzad pa/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs byed tshul gyi yig rnying / gzungs kyi mchan dang de'i gsal byed sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ de'i lag len rig 'dzin grags kyis mdzad pa/ man ngag zur pa la tshar gsum khug pa rje pas mdzad pa/ yi ge brgya pa'i gdams ngag gi yig rnying / sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa la shan+ti pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa dang / dzñā na shrī dang / rin chen rdo rje gsum gyi bar chad gsum sel/

ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal/ nā ro pa'i sdug bsngal gsum sel rnams thos/ de rnams kyi kha skong rje bla ma kun dga' bzang po/ yab sras gnyis kyis mdzad pa la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal rin chen rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i lam 'bras bshad thabs kyi man ngag gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ khrid yig tshigs bcad ma'i sa bcad/ lam zab nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rtogs bskyed/ bir srung bar chad kun sel/ sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi zin bris/ bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ de nyams su blang tshul/ de dang lam 'bras mtshon bya mtshon byed du sbyar ba/ bir srung gsar ma rnams thos/ rje sems dpa' chen po dpal mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang len tshul/ gtor chog bar chad kun sel/ khrid kyi zin bris che chung gnyis/ lam zab kyi nyams len byed tshul/ kun mkhyen gyi man ngag rnam bshad/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan rnams thos/ mdor na gsung ngag rin po che dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs/ lung man ngag nyams len gyi gnad thun mong du grags pa dang ma grags pa yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dza ya badz+ra dha ra/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka badz+ra nai rat+ma/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ yo ga shwa ra bi ru pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ ā tsar+ya kah+sa pa/ slob dpon nag po pa/ de sha ma dha ma s+ya dzo gi yul dbus kyi rnal 'byor pa/ bhaṭ+ṭa ra kā wa dhu ti/ rje btsun gnyis spangs/ paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī dzñā na/ mkhas pa rin chen dpal ye shes/ lo tsā ba shākya dzñā na/ lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ gu ru sarba bid/ bla ma kun rig

gu ru dharmā dz+wa la/ bla ma chos 'bar/ mahā bhu mi paṇ+ṭu ā nan+da gar+bhaḥ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ ā tsar+ya rat+na pu ṇ+ya gra/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka rat+na kirti dh+wa dza/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bhu mi paṇ+ḍu paṇ+ḍi ta nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/ sa skya pa lnga rig mkhas pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ar+ya ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rat+na shrī/ dkon mchog dpal/ pu ṇ+ya shrī/ bsod nams dpal ba/ saṅgu ru pu ṇ+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ shrī wan shi la/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ dharmā swa mī dzñā na dh+wa dza shrī bha dra/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ badz+ra dhā ra nan+da bha dra/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mahā satwa rat+na dh+wa dza/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sad+dhi shwa rā nan+de shwa ra/ grub pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' dbang phyug sa tu sidhi shrī wan badz+ra/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ sarba dzñā pu ṇ+ya singha/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge swa mi rat+na war+dha/ rje dkon mchog 'phel ba/ bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka bud+dha rat+na/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ mañdzu badz+ra ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje kun dga' bsod nams/ mahā paṇ+ṭi ta rat+na nī ra bho ṣa/ mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub/ shrī bhu mi paṇ+ḍu mahā man+t+ra dh+rika wa gin+d+ra ā nan+da rat+na/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ sidhi shwa ra puṇ+ya in+d+ra/ grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po/ mā ma u pa sa wa gin+d+ra nan+da pu ṇ+ya kirti dh+wa dza shrī bha dre ṇa shru te/ bdag dge bsnyen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos thos so/

/yang na rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rjes su/ bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka rat+na sa mu tra/ rje btsun dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ dharmā swā mi rat+na shrī wan/ chos kyi rje dkon mchog dpal ldan/ de gnyis ka la grub mchog dbang pos gsan no/ /brgyud pa de dag ni gong du bstan pa'i gsung ngag rin po che dang 'brel ba'i chos skor phal che ba rnams kyi brgyud rim yin la/ de rnams kyi nang nas byin rlabs sogs cha lag rnams kyi brgyud pa dmigs bsal dgos pa la/ ring brgyud zhang dgon pa ba nas rje sa chen la rim par brgyud pa'i cha lag rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ brgyud pa gong ma rnams la gzhung khrid dang 'dra ba las/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa nas/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ de la kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge dang / grub chen dkon mchog blo gros gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis kyis rjes su bzung ba rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ /yang na sa lo tsā ba'i rjes su/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rje grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ /brda chig brgyud kyi man ngag gi yig skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ rje sems dpa' chen po yan chad gong dang 'dra/ de nas kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba man gong dang 'dra/ yang na ngor chen/ kun dbang / 'dren mchog sa lo tsā ba man gong bzhin no/ ༈ /bsgrub pa'i lung sbyin nyams len man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen/ kun dbang / 'dren mchog sa lo tsā ba man gong bzhin/ yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang / kun mkhyen/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo man gong bzhin no/

/de rnams ni ring brgyud kyi skor ro/ ༈ /nye brgyud rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pas rje sa chen la gnang ba'i lcags ri khong mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhir grags pa la/ thog mar lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs dang / chos skor rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs bsgom rin po che/ chos rje nyan chen pa/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen kun bzang / mus chen/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / mkhas grub dpal rdor ba/ kun mkhyen lnga kas rjes su bzung ba 'dren mchog sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub de la/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan gsum gyis gsan/ de gsum char gyis rjes su bzung ba rdo rje 'chang bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang / mkhan chen legs 'byung / sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chen po man 'dra/ yang na bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra/ yang na mus chen/ kun mkhyen/ 'dren mchog gsum kas rjes su bzung ba sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa skya lo tsā/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ ༈ /bla ma rin 'byung gi brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ kun dbang / 'dren mchog sa skya lo tsa ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na mus chen/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ ༈ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi byin rlabs dang / bir srung thun mong ba'i brgyud pa lam zab dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang kun bzang / mus chen/ kun dbang pa/ 'dren mchog sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o/ /yang na mus chen/ grub chen dkon blo/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa skya lo tsā ba man 'dra/ yang na rgyal tshab kun dbang / mkhan chen legs 'byung / sa skya lo tsā/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ ༈ /gsung ngag rin po che'i man ngag gi don thams cad bsdus pa brda don gsal ba'i man ngag gi nyams len gyi gnad zab mo du ma dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bir+wa pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ bla ma lung phu nam mkha' bsod nams/ mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ blo gros brtan pa gnyis kas rjes su bzung ba bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun bzang / mus chen dkon rgyal gnyis kas rjes su bzung ba rgyal tshab kun dbang / yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na mus chen/ kun mkhyen/ rje sangs rin/ sa lo tsā ba man 'dra/ ༈ /lam sbas bshad kyi thugs rdo rje'i khrid/ 'khrul 'khor/ grub chen bcu/ phra mo brgya dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na kun mkhyen/ mus chen sangs rin/ sa lo man 'dra/ ༈ /sbas bshad 'khrul 'khor so gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ nyan chen pa nas/ gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan 'od/ 'gro mgon bsod nams pa/ bla ma dpal ldan pa man 'dra/ ༈ /pho brang lnga'i sbas bshad kyi 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ nyan chen pa/ dkar po brag pa/ dpal ldan pa man 'dra/ ༈ /rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ bir+wa pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ skyo ston dri med/

zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ 'gro mgon bsod rgyal/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ kun mkhyen/ rje sangs rin/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang skyo ston dar ma ye shes/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man chad gong dang 'dra/ yang na rje btsun/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa se ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ 'gro mgon bsod nams pa sogs snga ma bzhin no/ /tshar gsum khugs pa'i man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan chad lam 'bras dang 'dra ba'am/ yang na 'brog mi nas/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ sgyi chu ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ gzhon nu grub/ zhang byang chub shes rab/ 'gro mgon bsod nams pa/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ rje bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun bzang / mus chen dkon rgyal/ rgyal tshab kun dbang ba/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chen mo man 'dra/ yang na 'dren mchog rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ ༈ /sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa las/ mdo rgyud bsre ba'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon shan+ti pa/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ se ston kun rig zhag dgon pa ba/ sa chen/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ lung phu ba/ bsgom pa nam bsod/ mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub/ zhan ston byang she bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal tshul ba/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / mus chen dkon rgyal/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ de la sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dang rje dkon mchog dpal ldan gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka la grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa skya lo tsā ba/

rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ ༈ /bar chad gsum sel gyi brgyud pa ni/ dzñā na shrī/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ rin chen rdo rje gsum la 'brog mis gsan/ de la bsgom chen se rog gnyis kas gsan/ de la gnyos/ yer pa bsgom seng / grub thob lha 'bar/ kha rag bsgom pa/ lung phu ba sogs snga ma ji bzhin no/ ༈ /gnyug ma dran gsal gyi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ 'brog mi/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen/ rje btsun sa paṇa/ lung phu ba sogs sngar bzhin no/ ༈ /sdug bsngal gsum sel gyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun nā ro pa/ 'brog mi/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ gsal ba'i snying po/ sgyi chu ba/ sa chen/ rje btsun la sogs gong bzhin no/ ༈ /pod dmar la dkar chag nang bzhin yongs rdzogs kyi lung rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub las ji ltar gsan pa bzhin/ de'i sku'i dbon po rje dkon mchog dpal ldan drung du e waṃ g.yab khrar rje grub mchog dbang po nyid kyis gsan gsungs/ ༈ /rjes gnang gi skor la/ thog mar sgrub thabs kun las btus sam/ rgya mtshor grags pa'i rjes gnang rnams rdzogs par thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta ku mu ta 'byung ba'i blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dam tshig gsum gyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje gdan gyi man ngag gi cho ga dpal rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs/ yang dpal rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs/ yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ za ma tog bkod pa'i man ngag gis mdzad pa'i yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ yang yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ khar+sa pa ṇi 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs rnyog pa med pas mdzad pa/ po ta la khar+sa pa ṇi'i sgrub thabs slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/

khar+sa pa ṇi'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bde byed kyis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs a nu pa ma rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ yang seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs/ ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs cho ga bsdus pa/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ yang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ ha ri ha ri la bzhon par gyur pa'i sgrub thabs/ ha ri ha ri la bzhon par gyur pa'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lhag par dbang du bya ba'i cho ga 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mgrin pa sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ pad+ma'i phyag gi gzungs/ nye bar spyod pa dang bcas pa sran ma ma sha'i zhal gyi gzungs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa/ 'phags pa bhuk+ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon shu n+ya ta sa mā dhī badz+ra pā da'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bha wa kan+dhas mdzad pa dang / tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/

'jam dpal seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta yid bzhin nor bus mdzad pa/ dpal ldan ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'phags pa ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ shes rab 'phel ba'i gter ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dpal ldan 'phrog byed 'joms pas mdzad pa/ tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgom pa'i man ngag a ra pa tsa na 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ yan lag med pa'i sgrub thabs/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje sgrub thabs/ chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ sems can dbang du byas pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ yang chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ yang a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa'i sgrub thabs/ chos dbyings dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs kyis dbang du bya ba'i cho ga yang ngag gi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal rgyal po rol pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ bung ba myos pa'i sgrub thabs/ lhag par dbang du byed pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ yang 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa so so nas bsdus pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ shes rab 'phel ba'i cho ga mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i man ngag shes rab 'khor lo'i dngos grub mchog gi sgrub thabs/ chos kyi dung gi ting nge 'dzin 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ yi ge gcig pa'i rab tu sbyor ba'i sgrub thabs/

gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs cho ga dang bcas pa 'od zer 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ yang gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ sgrol ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ mchog sbyin sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang byed sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rdo rje'i myu gus mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs tshul mi 'dra ba gsum las/ gcig slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ yang rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta slob dpon chos 'byung zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma nor sbyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od dpag med kyi snying po'i rgyud las 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtogs pa gsungs pa/ ngan song las sgrol ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs/ don thams cad rab tu sbyin pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ de'i gzungs/ yang dug sel ba'i sgrub thabs/ de'i rigs sngags sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i rtogs pa dzaṃ gu ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta'i rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ de'i man ngag yang sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gnas brtan dpe med kyis mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag rim pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag chen po'i rim pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon brtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/ yang 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gi slob ma thu bos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal pos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/

ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs che chung mi 'dra ba lnga las gcig slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ tsun+da'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gsum/ rtogs pa las phyung ba'i 'od zer can phyag bcu ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ rtogs pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can ser mo phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs/ au ḍi ya na'i 'od zer can phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ au ḍi ya na'i 'od zer can dmar mo phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ 'od zer can dmar mo phyag bcu ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i jag 'chings/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon snying po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can pi tsu ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ de'i gzungs bklags pa'i man ngag ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi gzungs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dge 'dun sbyin gyi bus mdzad pa/ yang shes phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma 'phel gyis mdzad pa/ gser mdog can gyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ shes phyin gyi sgrub thabs/ yang gser mdog can gyi shes phyin gyi sgrub thabs/ shes phyin gyi sgrub thabs 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ dbyangs can ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/

rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ rdo rje pi waṃ ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs gshin rje nag po las gsungs pa/ yang rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ sgrol ma'i rtog pa las phyung ba ku ru ku l+le'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma'i rtogs pa las byung ba rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ de'i dbang du byas pa'i man ngag yang rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ u rgyan nas byung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa rol pa'i mdzad pa'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ kyai rdo rje'i rim pas rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud nas phyung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ rig byed ma phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ rig byed ma phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs in+t+ra bhu tis mdzad pa/ yang rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ de'i man ngag gi rim pa/ rig byed ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru ku l+le'i las rab tu bskyangs pa'i sbyor ba/ rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ gdugs dkar can gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje tsa rtsi ka'i sgrub thabs/ so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gsum/ stong chen mo/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ rma bya chen mo/ bsil ba'i tshal zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ phyir bzlog ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje ghan+da ri'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ srung ba lnga'i cho ga rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ paṇ+ṭi ta chos kyi 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/

gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gsum/ de'i gzungs kyi man ngag phag mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i mdzad pa'i dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs/ dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gsum/ ser po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa/ ser po lha pho brgyad mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i rgyas bsdus gnyis/ de la chu rgyun du 'bul ba'i man ngag gi rigs mi 'dra ba gsum/ slob dpon tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ rtog pa bdun pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta shar+dha ka ras mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs/ rta mchog gi sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs/ gshin rje nag po'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ yang dgra nag gi sgrub thabs/ gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ stobs po che'i sgrub thabs slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ yang stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ kyai rdo rje'i phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs tā ra shrīs mdzad pa/ bdag med pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs/ de'i cho ga dam pa thams cad 'dren pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ yang nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs te lha 'di rnams kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ a bh+ya ka ra/ shu bhaṃ ka ra gup+ta/ pu dza ti/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ go taṃ shrī/ kirti paṇ+ḍi ta/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rgyal mtshan rin chen/

gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ ka bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge thar rtse ba sangs rgyas seng ge mkhan chen chos 'od zer/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen/ mus chen/ 'dren mchog man gong dang 'dra/ yang na ngor chen/ 'jam dbyangs shes rgyam pa/ 'dren mchog man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen/ dpal rdor ba/ 'dren mchog man gong dang 'dra ba'o/ ༈ /sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa sgrub thabs dgu bcu go drug paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i rjes gnang thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ dang po thub pa rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum/ gnyis pa brtan pa'i 'khor lo bha wa kan+tas mdzad pa/ gsum pa yang brtan pa'i 'khor lo/ bzhi pa tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo/ lnga ba tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa na dkar po pad+mas mdzad pa/ drug pa a ra pa tsa na dkar po lha lnga mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ bdun pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ brgyad pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso 'khor lnga/ dgu pa ngag gi rgyal po gtso 'khor gnyis/ bcu pa rgyal po rol pa/ bcu gcig pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod nas gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal/ bcu gnyis pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod nas bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal/ bcu gsum pa yang 'jam dpal/ bcu bzhi pa yan lag med pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ bco lnga pa 'jam dbyangs chos dbyings gsung dbang / bcu drug pa mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'jam dpal/ bcu bdun pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa/ bco brgyad pa 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo/ bcu dgu pa 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ nyi shu pa gshin rje nag po zhal drug pa/

nyer gcig pa gshin rje nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ nyer gnyis pa gshin rje pu dza na bha dras mdzad pa/ nyer gsum pa rdo rje chos/ nyer bzhi pa seng ge sgra/ nyer lnga pa ha la ha la lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ nyer drug pa khar+sa pa ṇi lha lnga rnyog pa med pas mdzad pa/ nyer bdun pa yi ge drug pa gtso 'khor gsum pa lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ nyer brgyad pa ha ri ha ri la bzhon pa/ nyer dgu pa ha la ha la lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ sum cu pa pad+ma gar dbang sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa/ so gcig pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i spyan ras gzigs dgra las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ so gnyis pa sgrol ma rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa/ so gsum pa sgrol ma dkar mo gtso 'khor gsum pa yid bzhin nor bu rgyal pos mdzad pa/ so bzhi pa seng ldeng nags sgrol gtso 'khor gsum pa sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa/ so lnga pa sgrol ma dkar mo ngag dbang grags pa'i sras kyi thu bos mdzad pa/ so drug pa o rgyan gyi 'od zer can/ so bdun pa rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can/ so brgyad pa rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo/ so dgu pa mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can/ bzhi bcu pa o rgyan gyi 'od zer can lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa/ zhe gcig pa yang o rgyan gyi 'od zer can/ zhe gnyis pa tsun+dha/ zhe gsum pa gnod gnas ser po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ zhe bzhi pa dzam+bha la nag po dag pa byin gyis mdzad pa/ zhe lnga pa nor rgyun ma/ zhe drug pa khro gnyer can/ zhe bdun pa byams pa/ zhe brgyad pa shes phyin dkar mo sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa/ zhe dgu pa shes phyin dkar mo dge bsnyen gyi bus mdzad pa/ lnga bcu pa shes phyin dkar mo/ nga gcig pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ nga gnyis pa mdor bsdus pa'i shes phyin/ nga gsum pa mi g.yo ba sngon po pra bha ka ra karti dang gzhon nu sbas pas mdzad pa/ nga bzhi pa gtum po chen po/

nga lnga pa rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad/ nga drug pa ri khrod lo ma can ma/ nga bdun pa dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ nga brgyad pa bgegs dgra nga dgu pa ral gcig ma/ drug cu pa dug sel ma/ re gcig pa rig byed ma/ re gnyis pa rtog pa las gsungs pa'i rig byed ma/ re gsum pa o rgyan gyi rig byed ma/ re bzhi pa o rgyan nas 'byung ba'i rig byed ma/ re lnga pa khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs sa ra has mdzad pa/ re drug pa gnod gnas dang nor rgyun ma gnod sbyin pho mos bskor ba/ re bdun pa rgya nag rim pa'i sgrol ma brtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ re brgyad pa rdo rje sgrol ma lha bcu gcig pa/ re dgu pa gshin rje gshed dmar po yab yum/ bdun cu pa so sor 'brang ma/ don gcig pa gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ don gnyis pa rma bya chen mo/ don gsum pa stong chen rab 'joms/ don bzhi pa gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ don lnga pa bsil ba'i tshal chen mo/ don drug pa phyir bzlog ma chen mo/ don bdun pa rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ don brgyad pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rnam rgyal/ don dgu pa rdo rje gan+dha ris/ brgyad cu pa nag po chen po bram ze mchog srad kyis mdzad pa/ gya gcig pa lcags sgrog ma/ gya gnyis pa stobs po che/ gya gsum pa gdugs dkar can/ gya bzhi pa rta mgrin/ gya lnga pa he ru ka gya drug pa bdag med ma/ gya bdun pa yang bdag med ma/ gya brgyad pa gser mdog can gyi shes phyin/ gya dgu pa rdo rje phag mo/ dgu bcu pa rig byed ma/ go gcig pa sgrol ma dkar mo ste grangs dang go rim 'di rnams rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi gtad rgya'i yi ge bzhin bkod pa yin no/ /lha de rnams kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ dze ta ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/

rje btsun chen po/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma tshogs bsgom pa/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ bla ma gzungs kyi dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan pa/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na ngor chen/ mus chen/ kun mkhyen bsod seng / 'dren mchog man 'dra'o/ /yang na rdo rje 'chang kun bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel ba man 'dra'o/ ༈ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shar+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin bzang / brag steng ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na 'phags pa rin po che yan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rdo rje/ sa skya lo tsā ba man 'dra'o/ ༈ /mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug stobs 'phrog nag po chen po rtsa tur mu kha sgrub dus thun mong ba'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang /

klu sgrub/ bā liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal de wa/ bi ma la gup+ta/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ kha 'ub pa/ sa chen/ slob dpon sku mched/ chos rje khu dbon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ yar klung pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje rdo ring pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na bla ma dam pa/ bdag chen kun dga' rin chen/ bzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun kun spangs chen po man 'dra/ ༈ /gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra ming sring gsum gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pā la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin chen bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya pa paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ sa skya lo tsā ba/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /rje btsun mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs kun las btus kyi chings sbyar ba zhig kyang nos so/

༈ /lung gi skor la/ thog mar rgyud rgya gzhung sgrub dkyil sogs rgya bod kyi gsung rab thor bu ba du ma'i lung thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ kyai rdo rje rtsa brgyud brtag gnyis 'phags mchan dang bcas pa'i bshad lung / kyai rdo rje'i bstod pa nyi shu pa slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ daṇ+ḍa ka rje pas mdzad pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i kun rig gzhan phan mtha' yas/ cha gsum gtor ma'i cho ga gur drag gi 'phrin gzhung rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs/ lus dkyil dbang chu rnams kyi mdzes rgyan/ gur gyi mgon po'i bskang gso nag po mchod rten dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa/ lha mo'i spyan 'dren de wi ko tra ma bdag chen blo gros pas mdzad pa/ bskang gso chos nyid ma dam pas mdzad pa/ sku dang gsung thugs ma bla ma mal gyis mdzad pa/ gtum chen ma rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ gdong bzhi pa'i bskang gso lha mchog ma bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa/ stobs 'phrog dang / las mkhan gyi bskang gso che ba bdag chen rgya dkar bas mdzad pa/ lha mo'i bskang gso chung ba gzhan yang ma dang / las mgon gyi bskang gso chung ba dam pa'i mdos bskangs nas bsdus pa/ dkar bdud kyi bskang gso che ba bdag chen rgya dkar bas mdzad pa/ chung ba sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod 'phags pas mdzad pa/ chos skyong gi dpang gzugs rgya gar slob dpon bram ze nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ bka' srung khyad par can rnams kyi bstod pa'i skor la/ mgon po'i bstod pa srin gzugs ma bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ lha mo'i bstod pa gang sku ma 'phags pas mdzad pa/ zhal gyi bstod pa dpal ldan dbang ldan ma rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ mgon po'i bstod pa sngon tshe ma/ lha mo'i bstod pa til dmar ma/ zhal gyi bstod pa rdo rje 'chang dbang ma gnam kha 'ub pas mdzad pa/

mgon po'i bstod pa gang thugs ma 'phags pas mdzad pa/ lha mo'i bstod pa mi pham ma/ zhal gyi bstod pa pam̐ pad ma gnyan los mdzad pa/ mgon po'i bka' nyan nag po gnod sbyin sogs las mkhan lnga sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa'i bstod pa rgyas pa mal los mdzad pa/ mgon po'i bstod pa hūm̐ yig ma/ lha mo'i bstod pa rba klong ma/ zhal gyi bstod pa mi rtog ma/ las mkhan gyi bstod pa dang bcas pa chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa nag rngam ma theg chen kun bkras kyis mdzad pa/ rab 'bar ma kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro spyi bstod/ zhal gyi bstod pa stong nyid ma bla ma dam pas mdzad pa/ mgon po'i drag bskul dus gsum rgyal ba ma 'phags pas mdzad pa/ lha mo'i gson cig ma bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ las mkhan gyi bskul/ dam can mon bu ma bdag chen rgya dkar bas mdzad pa/ rdo rje phur pa'i bzlog pa 'khor lo rtsibs bcu ma/ ltas ngan brgyad cu'i bzlog pa/ phur bsrung dam can bcu gnyis kyi bskul slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa rnams thos/ gsung rab de rnams kyi lung grub mchog dbang po'i zhabs kyis sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po la gsan gsungs/ ༈ /slob dpon dze ta ri'i thugs kyi yang snying rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i tshe sgrub kyi gdams pa zab mo sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yan chad snyan brgyud kho nar bzhugs pa sngags 'chang de nyid kyis grub rgya gling pa pad rgyal gyi don du yi ger 'god pa mdzad pa'i tshe sgrub kyi man ngag zab mo'i bsgom lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā rī dgra las rnam rgyal/ slob dpon byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ bla chen bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya pa paṇ+ḍi ta/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma bkra shis 'od zer/

e pa 'khon ston/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ye/ grags pa dpal/ sru lung pa kun smon/ brag phug pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ ༈ /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen gyis slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la dngos su gsan pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo'i bsgom lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mahā paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen/ lo chen mañdzu shrī dzñā na/ mtshan ldan 'od zer seng ge mnyam nyid rin chen rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' lung rigs/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /tshe sgrub kyi yi ge rje nyid kyis mdzad pa yang thos so/ /paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gi tshe sgrub zab mo'i bsgom lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa chen po/ rnal 'byor pa sa ka pa la/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen/ lo tsā ba chen po mañdzu shrī/ mkhas btsun 'od zer seng ge mnyam med rin chen rgya mtsho/ grub chen kun dga' lung rigs/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /tshe sgrub kyi yi ge rje nyid kyis mdzad pa yang thos so/ ༈ /yang bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pa sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab rnams thos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ thog mar gsan yig thos pa rgya mtsho pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyi rnam thar blo gsar klu'i dbang po gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba/

'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam thar dge legs rin chen gter zhes bya ba/ de'i kha skong ut+pa la'i chun po/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa byin rlabs kyi chu gter zhes bya ba/ yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa'i cho ga bsdus pa/ byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ut+pa la dkar po'i cod pan zhes bya ba spyan ras gzigs la sbyar ba lha cig sangs rgyas skyabs ma la gnang ba/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi lam rim gyis sgo nas bla ma'i gsol 'debs/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la bstod pa thugs rje'i char 'bebs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po rnams la bstod pa re/ rje rang gi bdag bstod/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis dang / rje nyid rang la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa nus ldan dbang mo shrī de wa'i don du mdzad pa/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen dang / zhwa lu lo chen gnyis kyi bstod pa/ rje rang gi bdag bstod rnams skad gnyis/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ spros med brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ sbyor drug brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ de'i gsham na rin chen rgyal mchog zhabs la gsol ba 'debs zer ba'i sh+lau ka gcig dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i lam zab rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig ngo sprod dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rnal 'byor pa rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad zer ba'i nyis 'bigs/ kun rig brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ mi 'khrugs pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rdo rje phur pa'i stod las kyi dbang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong / yang rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa/

bde mchog bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs kha skong / snar thang dpe khang gi srung ma spe ha ra la 'phrin bcol sh+lau ka gnyis/ rta mgrin yang gsang bla brgyud kyi gsol 'debs/ gu ru drag dmar/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma dam pa la shugs ring dad pa'i rgyang 'bod thugs rje'i chu skyes zhes bya ba btsan la dbon po shes rab rgyal mtshan la gnang ba/ yon tan rgya mtsho ma'i tshig don gyi dogs dpyod ma rig mun sel rgya nag rgyal po la phul ba'i zhu yig mnga' ris rdzongs khar mnga' bdag rgyal po la gnang ba/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la phul ba'i zhu yig nyis 'bigs gcig dang bzhi/ zhwa lu lo chen la phul ba'i zhu yig e waṃ chos ldan gyi 'bul bsdud pa dge 'dun dpal bzang la gdams pa/ yig mkhan zla grags la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis/ lo dgon pa'i spyan snga la gnang ba'i bka' shog sdeb sbyor med pa gcig dang yod pa gnyis te gsum/ bla ma sgra tshad pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gnang ba'i bka' shog byang pa chos rje rin chen bzang po la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis/ thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi mkhan po chos rje blo gros rab yangs la gnang ba'i bka' shog rab 'byams pa kun tshe la gnang ba'i bka' shog smin drug lo tsā ba la gnang ba'i bka' shog gdong dga' ba kun spangs tshe ring grags pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog lhun grub rtse mkhan po thams cad mkhyen pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog 'dol kha rgyal po la gnang ba'i bka' shog rgyal mkhar rtser gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis/ seng ge rtse pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog dge legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa gcig dang bzhi/ gzhis dga' rin spungs pa dpon sogs la gnang ba'i bka' shog dgu dang / snar thang pa'i rtsom grogs zhus pa gcig tshong 'dus pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnas gsar pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnas pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis/ rtsed pa nam mkha' la gnang ba'i bka' shog rin chen rtse'i gnyer pa dkyil 'khar seng sding la gnang ba'i dris lan bka' shog

khams kyi 'bul bsdud pa bla ma sgra tshad pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ dge slong nam mkha' rtse mo/ rta 'bul ba mdo sngags rab 'byams pa kun dga' dpal 'byor rnams la gnang ba'i lam yig sde tshan gsum/ yig mkhan zla grags la gnang ba'i gdams pa/ mkhar spe rab 'byams pa blo gros rab gsal gyi dris lan gnyis/ rab 'byams pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gnang ba'i gdams pa/ gdong dga' ba kun spangs chos la bskul ba'i gtam/ byas 'gyur pa'i sgrub chen rnams la dge sbyor bskul 'debs/ snar thang stong dpon dpon blon la gdams pa gnyis/ rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi snang tshul rtsom 'phro gcig rje nyid rang gi thugs dam smon lam tshigs bcad ma/ dbu rtse rnying ma dang / sgo rum dpe khang gi rten gsum rnams kyi dkar chag tshigs bcad ma gnyis/ tshe lha dang nor lha'i tshigs bcad sh+lau ka gnyis/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du rje nyid kyi snam sbyar phul ba'i kha yig gser khang na bzhugs pa'i yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su rje nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i bla ma rin 'byung gi snyan dar kha yig rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyi nang rten gling dga' na bzhugs pa'i thub pa'i snyan dar kha yig sgo rum dang nang so'i dgon khang du gzhis dga' rin spungs nas gtor gsos gnang skabs kyi snyan dar kha yig le tshe dgu rtsed pa nam mkhas chos skyong thun mong du phul ba'i snyan dar kha yig gcig srub na bzhugs yod/ chos rje dkon mchog tshul khrims pa'i gdung rten rgyal rtse na bzhugs pa'i dngul gyi mchod rten la bsngags pa bkra shis kyi mgrin dbyangs zhes pa gcig dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la bstod pa/ gur mgon la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig dmar po skor gsum la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig mnga' ris rgyal po la gnang ba'i bstod pa/ rje nyid kyi bu slob sogs dad ldan so sos bskul ba'i ngor mdzad pa la/

byang pa bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa la bstod pa/ gu ge bzhi sde ba nam mkha' brtan pa la bstod pa/ dpal 'khor bde chen gyi mkhan po dkon mchog tshul khrims la bstod pa/ lo dgon pa'i spyan snga la bstod pa/ blo gros rab gsal la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig chos rje mgon po dbang phyug la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi gdan sa bkra shis brtan pa la bstod pa/ chos rje dpal ldan rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/ thub bstan yangs can gyi gdan sa pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/ skye rtsa mkhan po rdor 'dzin la bstod pa/ gting skyes pa chos rje kun dga' bkra shis la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig chos rje rdo rje seng ge la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig nyag re gser mdog pa'i bla ma la bstod pa/ jo nang mkhan po dpal ldan rin chen la bstod pa/ chos rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig chos rje kun dga' rgya mtsho la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig yang jo nang mkhan po la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig sgrub pa ba sangs rgyas dpal la bstod pa gcig ste tshan pa bco brgyad/ sgrub thabs skor la bla ma rin 'byung gi sgrub thabs/ bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i bsgom tshul/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub thabs nges don zla ba'i 'od zer/ sngags phreng phyag bris ma las zhal bshus pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs grol ba'i thig le/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i lus dkyil zur 'debs/ yang dag me gcig gi sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i khro bo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od can/ gu ru drag dmar gyi sgrub thabs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ srung ma drug cu'i gtor chog gshed dmar dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/

de'i rjes gnang byed tshul/ mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/ phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed/ seng gdong ma/ spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi sgrub thabs chung ngu gsum/ rjes gnang gi tho gnyis mchan du yod pa/ tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs/ tshe dpag med dze ta ri lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi rgya mtsho lha cig sangs rgyas skyabs ma la gnang ba/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs/ 'chi med sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal gur gyi mgon po khro bcu'i srung 'khor khams gsum bdud las rnam rgyal/ mgon po dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms rdo rje rnams so/ /nyer mkho la rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg sa skya pa'i dkar gtor cha bzhi gtong tshul gsung rgyun ma/ gtor chen zur 'debs/ rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi chog sgrig 'chi med dpal ster/ khro bo rme brtsegs kyi bstod pa grib sel kun grol/ bkra shis sh+lau ka gcig myur rtsis rnam dag skyon med nyer mkho kun gsal/ thub shing bgod bzhi'i yig chung / 'khor lo bde mchog gi 'chad thabs/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi sa bcad rtsom 'phro/ rdo rje phreng ba'i zin bris/ gnas yul rtsa khams kyi dbye ba/ zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs byed tshul/ dbang bshad mdor bsdus/ smon lam sh+lau ka gcig mgon po lha lnga'i dbang bshad/ byang pa bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa che 'don mdzad dus gnang ba'i mol gtam dgos pa skabs don/ rtse gdong pa'i sger gyi gdung rabs/ bsngo ba gcig rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad/ nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i bstod pa phreng 'dzin chos kyi nyin byed kyis mdzad pa la 'gyur gnang ba'i skad gnyis/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya mchan ma/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po mchan ma/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs ring gleng gzhi phan yon dang bcas pa 'di la skad gnyis med/

gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs mchan ma/ rdo rje'i glu mchan ma/ bi ru pa'i sngags aṅgu ri mchan ma/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi sngags phreng mchan ma/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa mchan ma/ sgra mi snyan gyi gzungs mchan ma/ tshe dpag med kyi gzugs ring thung gnyis mchan ma/ sgrol ma'i yi ge bcu pa mchan ma/ he ru ka'i yig brgya mchan ma/ bha ya na mchan ma/ kyai rdor gyi gtor sngags mchan ma/ mgon po'i yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang / bdun ma mchan ma/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi gtor sngags mchan ma/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs mchan ma/ tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs mchan ma/ rdo rje sgrol ma/ so so 'brangs ma/ stong chen mo/ rma bya chen mo/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ bsil ba'i tshal/ ri khrod ma/ sna tshogs yum rnams kyi gzungs mchan ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa mchan ma/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa mchan ma/ ngan song sbyong ba'i gzungs mchan ma/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs mchan ma/ 'chi 'joms 'khor bcas kyi sngags mchan ma/ gtsug tor dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ rten 'brel snying po rnams kyi gzungs mchan ma/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs mchan ma/ mchod rten bskor ba'i gzungs mchan ma/ yon sbyong ba'i gzung mchan ma/ sman byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags mchan ma/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sngags mchan ma/ gshin rje gshed kyi sngags mchan ma/ gnod sbyin pho mo'i sngags mchan ma/ rnam thos sras 'khor bcas kyi sngags mchan ma/ byin dbab pa'i sngags mchan ma/ gzungs gra lnga rgya dpe las dag par bshus pa/ tshe dpag med kyi mdo rnams la zhus dag dang 'gyur sogs mdzad pa'i skad gnyis ma/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid yig zur 'debs gsal ba'i sgron me/ gshed dmar gyi khrid yig gsal byed nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi them skas/ ku ru ku l+le'i rdzogs rim ut+pa la'i lcags kyu/ rdo rje phur pa'i 'cham bshad/

rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i gsal byed rin po che'i do shal/ sbyin sreg rdo rje'i me 'od/ gtor zlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi lhan thabs gsal byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i dbal/ mahā kā la'i gtor chog 'phrin las lhun grub/ mahā kā la'i gtor chog bdud las rnam rgyal/ dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len bklags pas grub pa/ dpal sa skya pa'i yi dam chos skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i tho snar thang dpon mo la gnang ba/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi bskang gso mnyes byed 'chi med sgra dbyangs/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i bskang gso dngos grub rol mtsho/ dpal mgon 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa dgra bgegs srog gcod kyi 'khor lo/ /dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri/ chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi bskyed chog dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gtor chog rdo rje phur pa'i srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral dang dam can gyi gtor chog dngos grub bsam 'phel rnams thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na sa lo chen po/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po man 'dra/ ༈ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i gsung rab rnams kyi lung thos pa'i tshul ni/ skyes chen gang gi ngo mtshar rnam thar cha/ /gang la bsams kyang dpyod ldan yid 'phrog pa'i/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/

/ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen rgyal gyur cig /ces pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams/ de'i bka' 'bangs kyi brgyud 'dzin gyi grangs mar gtogs pa sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag gis 'bad pa cher byas nas lung rgyun zhus shing phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs la/ thog mar bka' 'bum po ti dang po la sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa la bstod pa rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse ma/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub la bstod pa dkon mchog gdung 'dzin ma/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi bdag bstod sh+lau ka gcig gur mgon lha brgyad kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ dge sding mgon khang du phul ba'i mda' dar kha yig lam zab rgyun gyi nyams len/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid byin rlabs bya tshul/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i sgrub thabs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lung byin rlabs bya tshul/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nag po pa'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi cho ga'i gsal byed gsar bu'i blo can rtogs par sla ba/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi sngags phreng phyag bris ma las 'bru len byas pa shin tu dag pa/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi slob ma dbang bskur gyi mtshams sbyor slob dpon las dang po pa la nye bar mkho ba'i phyag len gyi rim pa gsal ba/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun gyi nyams len/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa ma rig mun sel/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga shin tu gsal ba/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa zin bris/ grib ma chung ngu khrus kyis sel ba'i cho ga

thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu bsgom tshul bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sbyar ba/ bdud rtsi'i ril bu sgrub tshul las dang po la mkho ba bdud rtsi'i 'byung ba/ man ngag lugs kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor/ kyai rdo rje rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rtogs pa bskyed/ lam dus kyi dbang bskur tshul kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa la mchan gnang ba/ lam dus nyams su len pa'i rim pa/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ bsgrub pa lung sbyin gyi gsal byed snying gi ze 'bru/ gshed dmar dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs gtor bsngo dang bcas pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gzhan phan don yod/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i phyag mtshan gzhan phan rgyas byed/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor gzhan phan lhun grub/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen gyi bca' yig bslab pa kun 'dus/ mkhan chen dpal ldan bzang po mdo khams la 'bul bsdud bskul la gnang skabs kyi spyi 'gro/ yang bla ma kun dga' dpal bzang mdo khams la 'bul bskul la gnang ba'i spyi 'gro/ deb gter rin chen bang mdzod/ dus mdos chen mo'i deb bris rnams bzhugs/ bka' bum po ti gnyis pa la/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub pa byed tshul/ mol gtam yid bzhin nor bu/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po de nyid kyi sras mchog sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po las rim par 'phel te/ dpal sa skya'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa rgyun ma chad pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du/ dus mchod pa sger gyi gdung rabs bsgrigs par mdzad pa'i yi ge nyung ngu / rab gnas don gsal gyi gsal byed dngos grub 'byung ba/ dpal yang dag mar me dgu pa'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba/

yang dag me dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rim pa gsal ba/ yang dag me dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga blo dman dga' ba skyed byed/ yang dag me dgu'i rdul tshon la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub mchod byed tshul ngag 'don gyi tho/ rdo rje phur pa'i rnga byin dbab kyi brda sprod mthong ba rang grol/ rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi gsal byed bdud rtsi'i nyi 'od can zhes bya ba sa los mdzad pa la sngags 'chang chen pos mchan gnang ba/ rdo rje phur pa'i stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas rang gzhan smin byed kyi phyag len shin tu gsal ba yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed/ rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor blo gsal dga' ba skyed byed/ drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang gi gsal byed rin chen phreng ba/ rdo rje phur pa'i dngos grub char 'bebs kyi 'cham gyi brjed byang snang ba 'gyur thub/ stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub pa'i dris lan/ dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha bzhon pa rnams bstan pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku bzhengs tshul yid bzhin nor bu mthong ba rang grol/ sgrub lnga'i nang gzungs 'bri tshul/ gur gyi mgon po'i khro bcu'i srung 'khor/ rdo rje brag rdzong ma bar chad kun sel/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed gdams pa rin chen 'bar ba/ mgon po'i lus dkyil rdzogs rim bsgom tshul gyi khrid yig kha gsal gzhan phan rgyas byed/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag len gyi rim pa ji lta ba'i gtor chog dpal sa skya'i bka' srung rnams kyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len shin tu gsal ba'i phyag len ma 'bring po/ gtor chog bsdus pa shin tu nyams len bde ba bar chad kun bcom dngos grub mchog stsol/ rang srung rgyas pa 'bri tshul shin tu gsal ba/ dpal ldan sa skya'i chos skyong khyad par can rnams kyi dus gtor gyi phyag len rol yig

gson po'i skra dang sen mo la tsha tsha btab pa'i yig chung / bdag chen kun legs pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog rnams bzhugs/ bka' 'bum po ti gsum pa la/ ka mad sum bcu la gras pa'i gsung mgur/ dngul chu chos rdzong gi rgyal sras thogs med pa'i sku 'dra la snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig ka mad sum bcu la gras pa'i sa lo la gsol 'debs/ byas 'gyur gnas bstod/ dbus phyogs su mdzad pa'i nyams mgur mkhyen brtse ma/ byas 'gyur sgrub chen dge slong kun dga' la gdams pa'i nyams mgur che chung gnyis/ yang byas 'gyur du gnang ba'i mgur ma gcig bsod nams chos kyi dpal 'dzoms la gnang ba'i nyams mgur/ skyid sdug med pa'i nyams dbyangs/ ye shes mkha' 'gro la gdams pa'i zhal gdams/ chos kyi rgyal po la gdams pa'i zhal gdams/ gong dkar dbon po mkhyen rab la gnang ba'i bka' shog gdong dga' chos rje la gnang ba'i bka' shog gu ru drag po'i dbang chog mthong ba rang grol/ gu ru drag po'i las mtha' gsal byed dgra bgegs tshar gcod kyi dpe/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dze ta ri lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang 'jug cing dbang blangs te slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i mtshams sbyor dang bcas pa/ tshe sgrub zab mo sa skya pa'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang chog rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid bklag chog ma/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes gnang bya tshul shin tu zab pa/ thub pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang bya tshul shin tu gsal ba/ tsa turmu kha'i rjes gnang bya tshul bklag chog ma/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang byed dus lung byed pa'i yi ge dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul sa lo'i gsung bzhin bkod pa/

pu tra ming sring gsum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul/ pu tra'i rjes gnang zur bka' byed tshul/ bran bdud gshin rje nag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bka' gtad bya tshul/ dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang bya tshul shin tu gsal ba/ mgon po lho nub pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ dzam dmar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang byed tshul bklag chog ma/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rjes gnang bya tshul/ grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi'i rnam thar/ gur gyi mgon po'i las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i 'cham dpe/ dpal sa skya'i chos skyong gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri zhes bya ba sa los mdzad pa la sngags 'chang chen po'i mchan bu gnang ba/ gtor ma brgya rtsa'i ngag 'don/ bum gter gyi lag len/ chu gtor gtong ba'i rim pa blo gsar dga' ba bskyed byed/ klu gtor gtong tshul gsal byed sgron me/ dkar bdud kyi bskang gso/ dmag zor rgyal mo'i bskang gso'i yi ge rnams bzhugs so/ /de rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ snyigs dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba gnyis pa ltar grags pa'i skyes chen dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de'i thugs sras grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /gsum 'bum de dag gi khrod nas grub thob brgyad cu'i rnam thar sogs dpe sna 'ga' re'i lung rgyun ni sngags 'chang nyid kyi dngos kyi slob ma 'jun pa chos rje la thug pa spyan snga rin po che/ dang brgyud pa'i slob ma gzhan dag las kyang nos mod kyi 'dir brjod bde ba'i phyir gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag bzhin phyogs gcig tu bris pa yin no// ༈ //'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung rab rnams kyi lung thob pa'i tshul ni/

mthu stobs dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /gang thugs ye shes ngo bo ro gcig pa'i/ /grub mchog ded dpon bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs/ /gus pas 'dud do brtse bas gzung du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa snyigs dus kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i gsung rab rnams/ de'i slob bu'i tha chung sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa la gsung 'bum po ti gnyis byung ba'i glegs bam dang po'i nang du bzhugs pa'i rim pa la/ rdo rje phur pa'i brgyud 'debs bar chad kun sel/ zab lam brgyud 'debs dgos 'dod kun 'byung / lam 'bras brgyud 'debs byin rlabs myur 'jug yang lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub bsam 'phel/ yang lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa byin rlabs myur 'jug dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i pho nya/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa/ gur drag bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ brgyud 'debs bsdus pa 'dod don myur 'grub/ zhal bzhi pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug sngags 'chang chen po la bstod pa byin rlabs dngos grub kyi char 'bebs/ yang sngags 'chang chen po la nang gi rnam thar dang mthun pa'i gsol 'debs/ rang rig bla ma'i gsol 'debs mthong ba rang grol/ bla ma'i bstod pa phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas/ 'dren mchog dam pa gzhon nu blo gros kyi sku bstod byin rlabs myur 'jug gdams pa zab mo khyad par can/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bsdus pa 'phrin las bsam 'phel/ mon bu pu tra'i drag bskul dam nyams tshar gcod dpa' bo'i 'brug sgra/
