srung ma spyi'i dmod bcol gyi bskul dam nyams tshar gcod rdo rje'i me dbal/ rten rdo rang byon lung bstan/ rol mo'i bstan bcos myong grub kyi lag len 'khrul med gcig shes kun grol/ ja mchod phun tshogs dge legs ma/ dam pa'i chos kyi dbye ba/ skyabs 'gro'i rnam bshad blo gsal dang ba skyed byed/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa shin tu bde ba/ bshes gnyen rnams kyis dris pa'i lan bstan pa rgyas byed/ dam tshig rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dam tshig gong 'phel/ tshe sgrub 'chi med lhun grub/ rig 'dzin tshe'i sgrub pa yid bzhin nor bu/ tshe sgrub 'chi med rdo rje/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs sdig sgrib kun 'joms/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs shin tu bde ba/ gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las lhun grub/ khro bo'i rgyal po rme ba brtsegs pa'i sgrub thabs bar chad kun sel/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs nad kun sel byed/ gsung ngag rin po che'i dmigs rim nyams su len tshul shin tu bde ba/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid yig gi yang snying bsdus pa tshig nyung don rgyas/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas par bskur ba'i cho ga grol lam mthar phyin/ dpal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul gyi bsgom don rnams phyogs gcig tu dril ba nyams rtogs gong 'phel/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig yid bzhin nor bu/ rten bskyed kyi yi ge mgon po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ mahā kā la'i nyams len nyon mongs rang grol gyi gdams pa/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i ja mchod ci bsam kun 'grub/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid yig shin tu go bde gsung rgyun gyi rim pa gsal ba dngos grub rgya mtsho 'di 'phro can yin/

rnams bzhugs so/ /de rnams kyis glegs bam dang po'i dkar chag bstan zin nas/ gsung 'bum po ti gnyis pa na bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin brlabs bya tshul gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu/ mahā kā la 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa khams gsum zil gnon/ bstan srung 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa bar chad kun sel/ dben gnas byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong gi gnas bshad dngos grub rgya mtsho/ bya btang ku sa li'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa ri khrod dbang po'i nyams mgur bde chen phun tshogs/ dben gnas ngo mtshar can phur ri rdo rje'i brag rdzong gi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rgya mtsho dgos 'dod kun 'byung / nyams dga' blo bde'i mgur/ nged rang la gnang ba'i zhal gdams dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshigs bcad dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bya btang ri khrod pa pu n+ya in+d+ras rang la rang gis gros 'debs kyi tshigs su bcad pa snying gtam yid bzhin nor bu/ mchog dman gyi gang zag kun la zhu ba'i phrin yig don gnyis lhun grub/ smon lam gyi tshigs bcad ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad bkra shis don grub gnyis/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtsho/ rang rig dbang bskur gyi bsgom tshul gcig shes kun grol/ slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dngos grub kun stsol/ grub chen shrī singha dang mjal tshul phyag bris ma las zhal bshus pa/ slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul grub gnyis bsam 'phel/ rdo rje phur pa'i las thig gdab tshul ma rig mun sel rnams bzhugs so/ /gsung rab de rnams kyi nang nas slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar sogs dpe sna 'ga' zhig gi lung rgyun ni grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid kyi dngos slob dang brgyud pa'i slob ma sogs gzhan las kyang nos mod kyi/

'dir brjod bde ba'i phyir gsung 'bum gyi dkar chag bzhin phyogs gcig tu bris pa yin la/ de las gzhan pa'i gong bkod bzhin gyi gsung rab rnams yongs su rdzogs par ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can nyid las dngos su thos so/ /'dir smras pa/ de bā su ra mu ku ṭi gi ri a gra/ lha dang lha min gtsug rgyan sa 'dzin rtser/ pā da ra dza sur+ya a dar+sha dzi ga /zhabs rdul nyi ma'i me long la 'tsho ba/ /hi ta su khaḥrasmi lak+ṣi na sa shrī/ /phan bde'i 'od zer 'bum phrag bzhad pa'i dpal/ /sid+dhi shwa ra pu ṇ+ya in+d+ra na ma/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang por 'dud/ /de ltar grub mchog ded dpon bka' drin las/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos dang thun mong gi /dngos grub mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter/ /stsol mdzad gang gi rnam thar bsam bzhin dad/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas khyed dang mjal re bzhin/ /thugs rje gting nas g.yos pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ /'dzum pa'i zhal bstan mdzes pa'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /lugs gnyis bslab byas yang yang blo mig phye/ /bka' drin de tsam kho nar ma zad kyi/ /nam yang 'bral med thugs rjes nyer dgongs te/ khyod rab tu byung phyin chad nged dang 'bral med lhan cig tu gnas dgos shing nga'i chos dang zang zing gi bdag po khyod kho na 'os yin no gsungs pa sogs/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i snang tshul rnams/ /dran pa'i mod la spu ldang mchi ma g.yo/ /bla ma pad+ma 'byung dang dbyer med thugs/ /thugs dang rang sems ro gcig lhan skyes ngang / /ngang de blos byas ma yin gnas lugs mchog /mchog de rtogs nas don kun lhun grub shog /chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thos pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las rje btsun grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyis rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te dang po'o//
